name: Dify Foundations v1
goal: Model the foundational business concepts of the Dify workflow platform so that workflow composition, node connectivity, inputs, and outputs can be queried and validated as a knowledge graph.
constraints: Model Dify Workflow, Node, Input, and Output as business concepts in the customer ontology, not as platform product concepts.
Capture node connectivity and ordering as modeled relations with provenance; do not invent connections absent from the sources.
Bound the first pass to workflow foundations; advanced node subtypes and plugins are out of scope unless a source supports them.
acceptance_questions: Which nodes can follow the LLM node in a Dify workflow, and what inputs do they require?
What outputs does the Workflow produce when an End node terminates execution?
Which node kinds accept a variable binding from a predecessor node output?
